summary: EGM publishes no quantitative performance results: no token, latency, accuracy, defect-rate, or success-rate figures. A design doc says outright that runtime and token costs have not been measured. Its verification is functional. TESTING.md records pass/fail end-to-end runs per harness (counts of reviewers launched, run durations). The repo also ships 43 deterministic behavioral scenarios in skills/*/test_scenarios.yaml, but has no in-repo runner and no committed results for them.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
